title: What A Whole Foods, Junk Food, & Keto Vegan Eat In A Day

locations.name: Los Angeles, CA (origin)
locations.basis: Speaker says 'I'm from L.A.'; filming location not confirmed.

summary: This Goodful video documents a day of eating across three distinct vegan dietary identities: a whole foods plant-based eater (Rachel), a junk-food vegan (Bridget), and a keto vegan (Maya). Over roughly twelve minutes, three hosts showcase breakfast, lunch, dinner, and dessert ideas tailored to their respective approaches, using a mix of whole foods, vegan substitutes, and convenience products. Dishes include sweet potato pancakes, a vegan egg McMuffin-inspired sandwich, chia pudding, a tahini-dressed salad, soyrizo tacos, a grain bowl, minestrone soup, vegan mac and cheese with buffalo wings, a chocolate-topped crunch bar, and a keto-friendly pad Thai. The video emphasizes texture, fiber, plant proteins, seasonal produce, and practical substitutions for vegan meals.
topics: folded egg (Just Egg) heated in toaster

sections.title: Sweet potato pancakes (keto-friendly breakfast)
concepts: mashed sweet potato + banana
wet ingredients: non-dairy milk, apple cider vinegar, neutral oil, vanilla
dry ingredients: oat flour, flax meal, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt
avoid overmixing; lump presence
pan-frying and flipping when bubbles form
toppings: coconut yogurt, blueberries, nectarines
sections.description: Demonstrates a breakfast prepared with mashed sweet potato and banana base, whisked with non-dairy milk and oil, bound with oat flour and flax, and cooked as small pancakes. Emphasizes light batter and gluten-free-ish ingredient choices; finished with yogurt and seasonal fruit.

sections.title: Vegan egg McMuffin-inspired breakfast
concepts: vegan bacon warming (Sweet Earth)
frozen hash browns
folded egg substitute heated in toaster
english muffin toasted
assembly with cheese slice and spinach
hot sauce addition
sections.description: Shows a plant-based take on a McMuffin using vegan bacon, a folded egg substitute heated in a toaster, hash browns, and a cheese substitute, all stacked on an English muffin and finished with spinach and hot sauce.

sections.title: Blueberry cinnamon chia seed pudding (keto-friendly)
concepts: coconut milk + almond milk blend
chia seeds for thickness and protein
cinnamon for flavor
blueberries folded in; chilling time implied
sections.description: A quick, high-fiber breakfast pudding using chia seeds and a dairy-free milk blend, flavored with cinnamon and blueberries for a simple, filling start to the day.

sections.title: Broccoli & kale salad with tahini dressing
concepts: shredded cabbage, kale, broccoli, peppers, edamame
tahini-based dressing (lime juice, soy sauce, maple syrup, water)
dressing emulsification and thinning to desired consistency
serving over greens
sections.description: A vibrant, fiber-rich salad with tahini-based dressing. Demonstrates a plant-forward dressing as an oil-free alternative and balancing acidity with lime, soy, and a hint of maple.

sections.title: Soyrizo tacos (vegan lunch 1)
concepts: onions grilled until soft
soyrizo with chili flakes
tortillas warmed; toppings: cilantro, onions, avocado
hot sauce (Valentina) added
sections.description: A quick plant-based taco using soyrizo and caramelized onions, assembled with tortillas and fresh toppings for a satisfying lunch.

sections.title: Grain bowl with roasted veggies
concepts: one-pan roasting of veggies with lemon, garlic, and olive oil
homemade barbecue rub (smoked paprika, mushroom powder, onion powder)
fresh basil
cauliflower rice as a base
sections.description: One-pan sheet-roasted vegetables finished with a fragrant garlic-lemon oil and a smoky, umami-rich rub; served atop cauliflower rice with fresh herbs.

sections.title: Minestrone soup (seasonal vegetables)
concepts: oil, onions, carrots, potatoes sautéed
garlic, dried basil, oregano; salt and pepper
green beans, heirloom tomatoes, crushed tomatoes
vegetable bouillon, eight cups water; simmer ~40 minutes
zucchini, cannellini beans, chickpea pasta, kale
sections.description: A hearty, vegetable-forward minestrone highlighting seasonal produce and pantry staples; demonstrates how to build a vegetable broth-based soup with legumes and a pasta substitute.

sections.title: Vegan mac & cheese with buffalo wings (dinner 1)
concepts: Trader Joe's pre-made vegan mac
seasoning: garlic powder, red chili flakes, pepper, nutritional yeast
panko breadcrumbs toasted
roasted buffalo-style wings using a vegan brand; air fryer 375°F for 15 minutes
sauce reduction in pan; serve with brussels sprouts as a side
sections.description: A convenience-forward vegan dinner featuring pre-made mac, a quick flavor boost with seasonings, and plant-based wings cooked in an air fryer with a hosted sauce reduction.

sections.title: Crunch bar chocolate shell over vanilla ice cream (dessert)
concepts: melt semi-sweet chocolate with coconut oil
ice cream scooped on plate
stir in rice Krispies for crunch
pour chocolate shell over ice cream
sections.description: A simple, nostalgic dessert styling a chocolate shell over vanilla ice cream with added crunch from rice Krispies.

sections.title: Keto Pad Thai (high-fat, low-carb dinner option)
concepts: peanuts, tahini, coconut oil for sauce
garlic, ginger, lime and lemon juice; water to thin
soy sauce, pepper
tempeh for protein; miracle noodles (tofu-based) as noodles
cabbed cabbage and carrot shreds as veg substitutes
stir-fry; coat with peanut butter sauce; cook until evenly coated
sections.description: A keto-friendly vegan take on pad thai using tempeh and tofu-based miracle noodles, a peanut-tangy sauce, and vegetable-forward preparation for a lower-carb alternative.
